body: Distribute and run LLMs with a single file.
plain_description: **Run open language models locally with a single file and no installation.** Distribute models as standalone executables across many operating systems. Transcribe and translate audio with the included whisperfile tool.
technical_description: llamafile packages llama.cpp and Cosmopolitan Libc into a single-file executable for running open LLMs locally across most operating systems and CPU architectures. It also includes whisperfile, a single-file tool for transcribing and translating audio, built on whisper.cpp.
title: llamafile
